d:
Opposition lawyer Jwala aggressively presents wedding photos and documents as proof. She cross-examines the Gokuldham members (Champaklal, Daya, Bhide, Dr. Hathi, and Taarak Mehta), cleverly twisting their answers to portray Jethalal as romantic, secretive, and habitual at lying.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
